verdict.rationale: Neon's hosted MCP server exposes SQL tools (run_sql, run_sql_transaction, explain) and schema tools (prepare/complete migration, compare schema). It offers documented least-privilege controls: `?readonly=true`, category scoping and project scoping. A keyless probe confirmed the read-only scoped tool list, with every tool flagged `readOnlySafe: true` and write tools removed. Branch-based migrations keep production untouched until changes are validated, and project-scoped API keys add credential scoping. Missing for 10: independent community or hands-on reports of agents using the destructive-vs-read-only split in practice, and evidence of per-call confirmation or annotation for destructive tools when write mode is enabled.
